Evelyn K: Customer 'Genova Health' billing noticed platform fee and support tier overlap on private deploy invoice 2026-GH-4402. They say support downgrade on 2026-02-01 not applied.
Marcus L: Pulled invoice, snippet:
```
Invoice 2026-GH-4402
Line A: PLATFORM_FEE_PRIVATE  1 x USD 9,000
Line B: SUPPORT_TIER_T3      1 x USD 7,500
```
Contract addendum GH-AMD-07 reduces support to T2 from 2026-02-01 and halves platform fee for that month.
BillingBot: Automated check: addendum GH-AMD-07 present but invoicing rule failed to apply proration. Opened ticket BILL-4662.
Priya S: Finance preference = corrected proforma + credit memo. Do we have legal sign-off?
Marcus L: Legal confirmed addendum effective 2026-02-01. No objections.
Evelyn K: I'll generate proforma and route for approvals. Please tag accounting code 4-REV-PlatformCredits for the credit.
BillingBot: Proforma 2026-PRO-099 queued. Credit memo CM-2026-GH-021 created for USD 4,500. BILL-4662 status: RESOLVED (proforma issued, credit applied).
